bands.unit: DN per Atlas pixel (1.375 arcsec), area mean
DN per Atlas pixel (1.375 arcsec), area mean

note: AllWISE Atlas image (IRSA, open S3 copy) resampled to this field's 3 arcsec grid: each grid pixel is the mean of 6 x 6 sub-points, each taking the Atlas pixel (1.375 arcsec) it falls in, i.e. an area average of surface brightness in DN per Atlas pixel (MAGZP 20.5). The Atlas co-adds WISE exposures from 2010 (epoch below is the tile's header MIDOBS; DATEOBS1/DATEOBS2 give the range); a moving source is where it was then, not where SPHEREx saw it.
